about: Held-out phrasings for the clarify pre-flight (agent/clarify.py), written after clarify-v2 by a second Claude workflow on 2026-10-17 (writers: older or low-vision users' variants of the 12 sandbox tasks and other clear portal requests, new ask cases, near-boundary proceed cases; told to avoid the first set's phrasings). Two independent judges labelled each phrasing; expect = the label all three agree on, else borderline (not counted). The writers never saw the clarify prompt, and the prompt was frozen (clarify-v3) before this set was first run.
